name: rotor-hover
airframe: any rotorcraft; a tiltwing/VTOL must already be in the HOVER configuration (a card never writes customAxis1)
note: The hover half of rotorcraft-v2 without its 3 min fixed-wing prefix, so it actually gets flown. Exercises the v0.58 hover regime (tilt-angle driven) rather than the wingborne one. UNGATED (startSpeed 0): no placement, no collective ownership and therefore NO per-replicate reset - establish the hover by hand and fly one replicate.
